backend/main.mo: Main canister actor defining user profiles, stats, availability, chat, and helper queries with access control and storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module copying old userStats and dailyLogs into identical new structures without transformation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata describing leaderboard timeframe consistency and related frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files used for documentation or build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app router and auth gate handling login, profile setup, actor readiness, and route configuration.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen displayed when a user lacks admin permissions with a link back to the calendar.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login page using Internet Identity with a styled background and branded card layout.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple logo component rendering the app’s branding image.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Chat interface fetching recent messages, rendering user avatars, and allowing message submission with scroll handling.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main page layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Renders navigation tabs with active state and conditionally shows an admin link.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Displays the top bar with logo, theme toggle, user avatar, and logout menu.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Shows and edits the user profile, including name and profile picture upload with progress.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the user’s weekly, monthly, and all‑time leaderboard ranks with loading states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user’s match history with wins/losses and handles loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Prompts new users to enter a name and saves their initial profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Wraps children with a subtle fixed background image.
Renders an avatar with initials and a display name in various sizes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the authenticated backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and updates the caller’s user profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Retrieves the caller’s role and checks whether they are an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching user profiles, availability, leaderboard data, and submitting availability changes through an actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state with localStorage persistence and DOM class updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Fetches user directory info, including display names and avatars, and provides helpers to get display names by principal.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and declares CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants such as app name and logo information.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides utilities for converting dates to IDs, formatting dates and times, generating calendar grids, and timeframe calculations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Page for adding or editing user availability, handling time selection, notes, and submitting updates via hooks.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing and deleting users and their day-specific availabilities.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Displays a month calendar with availability indicators and navigation between months.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Simple page wrapper that renders the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows availability details for a specific day with options to edit or delete the caller’s availability.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Renders leaderboard tabs and tables with actions to record or remove wins and losses.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page showing user info, leaderboard ranks, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utilities for converting files to Uint8Array and generating name initials.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Time utility helpers for generating time options, formatting, parsing, and defaults.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash-based), storing and retrieving them from sessionStorage, and persisting URL-derived values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project state, requirements, and issues focused on fixing leaderboard time‑window filtering based on user‑selected timestamps.
